sloka: इतस्तु किं दुःखतरं यदिमं वारिसम्भवम् ।मणिं पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीमागतं विना ।। ५.६६.९ ।।।।
transliteration: itastu kiṁ duḥkhataraṁ yadimaṁ vārisambhavam ।maṇiṁ paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīmāgataṁ vinā ।। 5.66.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Saumitri I see this jewel born (formed) under water but not her. What can be more sorrowful to me?
